elaine: Quick thread 1: proposal to add an explicit cluster slug in permalinks so deep links always resolve the same way across workspaces. Example: /ws/12/cluster:models/model-123/version -> deterministic highlight. Thoughts?
ravi: Love determinism but worried about existing links breaking. We should support legacy paths with a thin resolver that maps /ws/12/models/123 -> /ws/12/cluster:models/model-123 (301/compat).
hannah: Accessibility note: when rails are in compact icon-only mode, breadcrumbs become the primary orientation aid. Breadcrumbs must include cluster text even if rail shows icons only, otherwise SR users lose context.
maria: UX: two options for breadcrumbs in compact rail: 1) full breadcrumb line with cluster crumb, 2) cluster chip + reduced crumbs. Chip keeps length down. We should A/B test.
ravi: Dev concern: compact mode + hover-expand spectrum. Hover expand is fine for mouse, but keyboard users need a persistent toggle. So add a user pref (Settings > Navigation: compact/expanded/auto).
hannah: ARIA specifics: cluster chip should be visually present but aria-hidden if duplicate info is in the breadcrumb list. Breadcrumb nav needs aria-label="Breadcrumbs" and leaf item gets aria-current="page". Add live-region announcements for permalink fallbacks: "Linked item not found in this workspace 1 showing Models hub."
elaine: For permalink fallback UX, prefer non-modal banner with an action button "Try original workspace". Avoid forcing workspace switch. Keep local context.nav-bot: [ci] nav-permalink-compat-tests: passing but flaky on icon-only highlight. See https://ci/redwood/branches/compact-mode
maria: Action items: Ravi -> compatibility resolver + 301s. Hannah -> ARIA checklist and SR announcement examples. Elaine -> design two breadcrumb variants for A/B test (chip vs extra crumb). I'll set a 10-min sync tomorrow 9:45 PT to pick variant.
ravi: Will add a telemetry ping when fallback occurs so we can measure frequency.
hannah: I'll run a keyboard-only pass and include focus-ring screenshots.
elaine: Drafting AB test in Growth Console and will include simple success metric: fraction of users who find the target resource within 10s after landing from permalinks.nav-bot: [reminder] sync scheduled 2500004800
maria: Great. Meeting invite sent. :calendar:
